title: Senior data engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior data engineer em jacareí. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are:  We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals. The 3 G’s of RE:   “Get Shit Done.” “Get Over Shit.” “Give a Shit.” What You’ll Do:   Design and build Spark data ETL pipelines on AWS data platform.  Collaborate with cross functional teams such as data scientists, fraud, marketing and other business stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver reliable solutions.  Optimize data infrastructure - Design and maintain robust data infrastructure by using modern data platform architecture.  Ensure data quality and reliability.  Innovate and follow best practices.  Ensure operational excellence of the data platform, including monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.    Who We’re Looking For:   Professional experience working in data warehousing, data architecture, and/or data engineering environments, especially using spark, hadoop, hive etc with solid understanding of streaming pipelines.  Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language (Scala, Java, Python or equivalent) Good understanding of databases  You have built large-scale data products and understand the tradeoffs made when building these features  You have a deep understanding of system design, data structures, and algorithms  You have an excellent knowledge of distributed computing frameworks such as Hadoop Map Reduce, Spark  You have a strong knowledge of following AWS infrastructure - EMR, S3, Lambda, Redshift etc  You have strong understanding of data quality, governance  You are a team player, self-driven, highly motivated individual who loves to learn new things    Join Our Global Team:  We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus  Equal Opportunity Employer:  We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Technical product owner
description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical product owner em esteio. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.   WHAT WE OFFER   Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.  Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.  Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.  Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.  Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.  An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.    OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION  At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.  We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Trainee comercial — seguros | programa de formação caburé
description:
Nova oportunidade para Trainee comercial — seguros | programa de formação caburé em rio grande do sul. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Você, jovem que está iniciando no mercado de trabalho: Já pensou em construir uma carreira dentro de um dos setores que mais cresce no Brasil? Somos o  Grupo Caburé  , unimos a tradição dos seguros com a inovação da tecnologia. Nascemos com um propósito simples, porém poderoso: proteger pessoas.  Com  mais de 62 anos de história  , nossa essência está enraizada na confiança, na excelência e na capacidade de transformar vidas por meio de soluções acessíveis, inteligentes e humanas.  Atualmente, protegemos  mais de 2 milhões de brasileiros  , atingindo a marca de 28 bilhões de capitais segurados  , e a confiança deles segue sendo nosso maior patrimônio.  O Programa de Formação de Especialistas em Seguro de Vida da Caburé  foi criado para dar oportunidade de formação a novos entrantes no mercado de seguros, para quem tem ambição de crescer financeira e profissionalmente, ingressando em  um dos setores de maior remuneração do mercado financeiro.   SOBRE A VAGA:   A função é voltada para vendas consultivas, entendendo as necessidades dos clientes e oferecendo soluções personalizadas de proteção financeira. O profissional atuará com prospecção ativa, reuniões com clientes, planejamento financeiro e gestão da própria carteira. Aqui você vai aprender a fazer vendas de forma consultiva na linha de frente do mercado financeiro, onde um talento comercial tem o ambiente ideal para crescer de forma meritocrática. title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior voip engineer em araçatuba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing ai agent builder em caraguatatuba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing) em barretos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses). The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.  The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.  Financial   ● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.  ● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.  ● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates  ● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.  ● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients  ● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients  ● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions  Operational   ● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.  ● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.  ● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.  ● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.  Experience and Skills   ● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.  ● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance  ● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.  ● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.  ● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus  ● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.  ● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. title: English teacher
description:
Confira a vaga para English teacher em são josé dos pinhais. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!You be your own boss and set your own scheduleWork from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.C1 or C2 Level English SpeakerUniversity degree in English Teaching or related area.One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.Must pass a criminal background check.Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Artificial intelligence engineer em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title:  AI Engineer Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration:  Long Term  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours:  PST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview   We are seeking an experienced  AI Engineer  to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.” Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.    Preferred / Nice to Have    Experience contributing to an  AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence  .   Hands-on experience with:  LLM Agents  RAG pipelines  Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index  Exposure to  AI Fin Ops  , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.   Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Analista comercial - inside sales
description:
Confira a vaga para Analista comercial - inside sales em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Local: Greystar    Primeiramente, nós apresentamos:  Somos a Greystar, um conceito de apartamentos de aluguel totalmente equipados, com um serviço de gerenciamento profissional que está estabelecendo o padrão no mercado. Desde a nossa fundação, buscamos oferecer um estilo de vida exclusivo, focado em proporcionar aos nossos residentes uma experiência única.  Nosso principal objetivo? É oferecer um estilo de vida exclusivo focado em nossos residentes vivendo uma experiência única.  Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base em nossos pilares e valores; nossos pilares servem de guia para “o que fazemos” e nossos valores orientam “a forma como fazemos”. Acreditamos firmemente que a diversidade agrega valor. É por isso que nossos valores promovem um ambiente de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão, estabelecendo uma base e uma mentalidade pela qual orientamos os membros da equipe, nossos residentes, comunidades e parceiros. Somos uma empresa comprometida em criar um ótimo local de trabalho para todos e reforçamos isso com nossas iniciativas de diversidade, igualdade e inclusão.  Chamou sua atenção? Quer saber mais sobre as funções?  Perfil procurado:   Momento de carreira:  Profissional com experiência prática em vendas e atendimento. Alguém em fase de crescimento na carreira, com energia e ambição para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico.  Formação e experiências anteriores:  Preferencialmente com passagem por startups, ou empresas de tecnologia ligadas ao setor imobiliário principalmente de curta estadia, para entender mais do nosso dinamismo. Experiência com inside sales  , atendimento digital e foco em fechamento são diferenciais.  Habilidades técnicas:  Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de CRM, domínio do pacote Office (com foco em Excel) e boa fluência em Outlook. É essencial ter excelente escrita – clara, profissional e persuasiva, tanto para e-mails quanto para Whats App, além de boa comunicação presencial.  Comunicação e perfil comercial:  Boa escuta, empatia e firmeza para negociar. Buscamos alguém com perfil closer  , com habilidade para contornar objeções, ler o momento do lead e conduzi-lo até o fechamento.  Comportamento e atitude:  Perfil colaborativo, alto astral, despojado, com senso de dono e foco em metas. Flexível e adaptável a mudanças de processo, com facilidade em lidar com tecnologia. Valoriza o trabalho em equipe, mas tem autonomia para tocar suas entregas com responsabilidade.  Idioma:  Inglês intermediário, sendo capaz de conversar com clientes estrangeiros e explicar de forma clara o processo de locação.    Funções:   Gestão Comercial:  Gerir o ciclo completo de vida do cliente, desde a prospecção, acompanhamento e fechamento, visando a máxima ocupação das unidades (seguindo os padrões de qualidade da empresa).  Visitas Comerciais:  Realizar visitas comerciais aos imóveis, mostrando os apartamentos, explicando o conceito e também as áreas comuns.  Gestão de Clientes:  Contribuir proativamente para a construção e desenvolvimento da melhor experiência para os nossos clientes, organizando eventos, remoções e atividades diversas.  Gestão de Indicadores:  Monitorar diariamente os principais indicadores de gestão através do CRM.    Benefícios:   Vale Transporte  Cartão Alimentação Flash (flexível)  Comissão variável de acordo com a política vigente  Remuneração fixa mensal  Plano de Saúde – 100% subsidiado para titulares e dependentes  Plano Odontológico – 100% subsidiado para titulares e dependentes  Seguro de vida em grupo  Total Pass  Open English  Day-Off

description:

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Analista de pcp
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista de pcp em são bernardo do campo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a empresa  Prazer, somos a FHOM Alimentos Saudáveis, uma empresa familiar, com 32 anos de mercado fabricando alimentos puros e saudáveis. Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos.  Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 5 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM.  Temos como base de trabalho 3 grandes frentes onde nos baseamos para todas as decisões, são elas:  QUALIDADE / PESSOAS / INOVAÇÃ O  Atualmente o parque industrial tem 8.500m2 e 70 colaboradores diretos e mais de 100 indiretos.  Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos.  A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família.  Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal.  Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher.  A linha Bem Orgânico é o braço orgânico da FHOM Alimentos, que desde 2013 produz e é pioneiro na fabricação de batatas chips orgânicas do Brasil. title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Commercial lead — brazil em santa catarina. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração em ribeirão pires. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Descrição da Empresa:  A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Descrição do Cargo:  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior business analyst - supply chain em criciúma. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior business analyst - supply chain em florianópolis. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close. Job Title:  AI Engineer  Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration:  Long Term  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours:  PST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview   We are seeking an experienced  AI Engineer  to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.” Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Hands-on experience with:  LLM Agents  RAG pipelines  Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index  Exposure to  AI Fin Ops  , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.   Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations. Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Hands-on experience with:  LLM Agents  RAG pipelines  Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)  Lang Chain / Llama Index  Exposure to  AI Fin Ops  , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.   Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Analista de pcp
description:
Confira a vaga para Analista de pcp em são bernardo do campo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre a empresaPrazer, somos a FHOM Alimentos Saudáveis, uma empresa familiar, com 32 anos de mercado fabricando alimentos puros e saudáveis. Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos. Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 5 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM. Temos como base de trabalho 3 grandes frentes onde nos baseamos para todas as decisões, são elas: QUALIDADE / PESSOAS / INOVAÇÃO Atualmente o parque industrial tem 8.500m2 e 70 colaboradores diretos e mais de 100 indiretos. Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos. A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família. Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal. Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher. A linha Bem Orgânico é o braço orgânico da FHOM Alimentos, que desde 2013 produz e é pioneiro na fabricação de batatas chips orgânicas do Brasil. title: Supervisor de importação e exportação
description:
Nova oportunidade para Supervisor de importação e exportação em guarulhos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

A Brink’s  é uma empresa líder global em gestão de numerário e valores, soluções digitais para o varejo e serviços gerenciados de ATM.  Nossos clientes incluem instituições financeiras, varejistas, órgãos governamentais, casas da moeda, joalherias e outras operações comerciais. Nossa rede de operações em 51 países atende clientes em mais de 100 países.  Acreditamos na construção de parcerias que protegem o comércio, e isso exige fomentar uma cultura engajada que valorize pessoas com diferentes origens, ideias e perspectivas.  Construímos um senso de pertencimento, para que todos os colaboradores se sintam respeitados, seguros e valorizados, e oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades para participação e crescimento.  Como pessoa Supervisora de Importação e Exportação você será responsável por liderar e garantir toda a documentação necessária para os embarques nos processos de importação e exportação, cumprindo prazos e especificações dos órgãos legais e conforme determinação contratual.  Responsabilidades    Supervisionar diariamente no sistema da Receita Federal a existência de novos pedidos de embarque, acionando as áreas envolvidas e tomando as medidas necessárias;  Supervisionar o time quanto à documentação emitida a fim de evitar embarques incorretos;  Manter contato permanente com clientes externos e internos (nacional e internacional), avaliando a necessidade de correções de documentos e providenciando-os, a fim de manter os padrões exigidos pela legislação evitando penalidades e multas perante as alfândegas brasileira e do exterior;  Manter contato com o departamento de controle das filiais a fim de acompanhar as coletas (exportação) e entregas (importação) e posicionar Brink's e clientes quanto aos embarques cuja contratação é "porta a porta";  Supervisionar atividades administrativas como conferências e pagamento de frete aéreo internacional e valores a serem faturados;  Conhecer e interpretar os Inconterms (negociações entre importador e exportador) e providenciar instruções de emissão de documentos de acordo com o Incoterm negociado;  Seguir procedimentos internos de segurança e sigilo da informação;  Manter o cliente devidamente informado de todos os passos/acontecimentos do processo;  Participar dos programas de melhoria contínua e disseminar novas propostas de processos junto ao time.    Desafios    Garantir que os processos de importação e exportação ocorram de maneira correta e eficaz, providenciando todos os documentos necessários para embarque para exportação e conferência na importação, cumprindo os prazos estabelecidos e evitando penalidades e sanções.

description:

Job Title:  AI Engineer  Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)  Contract Duration:  Long Term  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)  Work Hours:  PST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)  Overview   We are seeking an experienced  AI Engineer  to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”  Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.    Preferred / Nice to Have    Experience contributing to an  AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence  .   Hands-on experience with:  LLM Agents  RAG pipelines  Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)  Lang Chain / Llama Index  Exposure to  AI Fin Ops  , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.   Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Chief technology officer - cto
description:
Empresa está contratando Chief technology officer - cto em blumenau. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Purpose of the Position   The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading Saa S platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.  More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.  Main Challenges and Assignments   Modernize without disruption:  Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle +. NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.  Act as the Integrator of the EOS model:  Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.  Professionalize the technology organization:  Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.  Build cohesion and leadership depth:  Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.  Sustain high performance and growth:  Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.  Influence and earn autonomy:  Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.  Drive engagement and culture:  Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.  Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders:  Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.  Prepare for scale and possible M&A:  Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.    Experience and Professional Qualifications   Technology leadership:  Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in Saa S, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.  Transformation delivery:  Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).  Systems architecture expertise  : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (. NET Framework,. NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).  Operational excellence:  Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).  Process & governance:  Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.  Stakeholder management:  Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.  Team scaling & culture:  Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.  Language:  Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.  Education:  Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.    Behavioral Skills   Ownership & Accountability  – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.  Transparent & Courageous Communication  – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.  Learning Agility & Adaptability  – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.  Executive Presence with Simplicity  – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.  Collaborative Influence  – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

QMS & BPF (GMP) Maintenance: Establish and maintain the Quality Management System in accordance with RDC 665/2022; lead ANVISA inspectionsand CBPF certification renewals. Technical Advocacy: Manage INMETRO certification processes for active devices (e. G., robotics and energy-based systems), including coordination of technical peer reviews of international IEC 60601 reports. Vigilance: Oversee the Technovigilance system, including adverse event reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions (FSCA) across the region.  Requirements Bachelor's degree in Biomedical, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering. Active and valid CREA (Conselho Regional de Engenharia) registration in Brazil is required. Minimum of 10 years of experience in Medical Device Regulatory Affairs, including at least 3 years in a regional LATAM leadership role. Fluent in English and Portuguese, with professional working proficiency in Spanish. Proven track record with Class III/IV (High Risk) devices. Experience with surgical robotics or energy-based surgical systems is highly preferred. Experience managing MDSAP audits and ANVISA BPF certifications Ability to balance commercial objectives with legal and technical independence Skilled in translating complex regulations into business insights; effective in navigatingthe high-stakes legal environment of being a designated RT.  About Genesis Med Tech WE MAKE BETTER HEALTHCARE HAPPEN. This is our quest: to make quality healthcare more affordable and accessible. Headquartered in Singapore, Genesis Med Tech shares a bold new world of value-based healthcare across surgical, cardiology and vascular interventional specialities. With an open platform that brings the best of medtech together from every corner of the globe, we disrupt the inefficiencies and fragmentation that keep quality healthcare out of reach for many. Genesis Med Tech aims to become the most scalable, efficient and transparent business platform for the medtech industry. At Genesis Med Tech, we are also actively growing our product portfolio through R& D and innovation, acquisitions, as well as partnerships with strategic startups. Website:  Genesismedtech. Com/
